slides.title: Split Layout — Bullets + Code Panel
slides.subtitle: Left: bullet list  ·  Right: syntax-highlighted code or query

left.heading: Key Points
items: Lines starting with -- or # render as comments in the right panel
The right panel background colour is configurable
Useful for showing code alongside its explanation
Set footer_strip to add a coloured strip above the footer

right.title: Code Example
right.code:
-- Select all active records
SELECT id, name, status
FROM my_table
WHERE status = 'active'
  AND created_at >= '2026-01-01'
ORDER BY name;
